---
title: "MB1A Practical 3"
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
library(cowsay)
set.seed(42)
```

```{r}
heists_vec = c("success", "failure")
heists_probs = c(0.3, 0.7)

heists = sample(heists_vec,
                size = 150,
                replace = TRUE,
                heists_probs)
print(heists)
```
```{r}
num_successes = sum(heists == "success")
say(paste("The squirrel was successful ", num_successes, " times."), by = "squirrel")
```
```{r}
combined_successes <- c()
for (i in seq_len(1000)) {
  heists <- sample(c("success", "failure"),
    size = 150,
    replace = TRUE,
    prob = c(0.3, 0.7)
  )
  num_successes <- sum(heists == "success")
  combined_successes <- c(combined_successes, num_successes)
}
print(combined_successes)
```
```{r}
df_squirrels <- tibble("N_Successful_Heists" = combined_successes)
gt(head(df_squirrels))
```
```{r}
ggplot(
  df_squirrels,
  aes(
    x = N_Successful_Heists
  )
) +
  geom_bar() +
  ggtitle("Number of Successful Heists per Squirrel - Simulated") +
  xlab("Number of successful heists") +
  ylab("Number of squirrels") +
  theme_minimal()
```
